title: HinterOS catalog index
description: Generated from apps/*.nix by lib.mkIndex (indexVersion 3). Read by the session daemon and the launcher's Store UI. Receivers ignore unknown fields and treat unknown enum values as documented.

kind.description: Entry kind. Apps are installed per profile and shown in the Store; services are box-wide, admin only, and shown in the Server section. Unknown values: ignore the entry.

type.description: web and native as in apps.list; service for kind = service. Unknown values: native.

icon.description: Where the session daemon finds the real icon at runtime; HinterOS ships no logos. siteUrl defaults to homepage.

iconUrl.description: The vendor's own public logo; the daemon downloads and caches it at runtime (https, at most 1 MiB). Optional.

box.description: Box features the app needs; the system turns them on box-wide when any profile has the app. Always empty for services

starter.description: Installer app step: null (Store only), offered (listed) or ticked (listed and pre-selected; implies onIso). Always null for services

onIso.description: Ships on the ISO, so an offline install can select it. Always false for services

dataPaths.description: Paths relative to a profile's home that hold the app's data; deleted in the removing profile's home only, when the user removes the app and chooses to delete its data

terms.description: The vendor's full terms, shown before install. null when the app has none

version.description: The vendor's version or revision date; the box records which version was accepted

retrieved.description: When the text was copied from url

file.description: Plain UTF-8 text, relative to this index file

buildsOnDevice.description: Unfree and not cached: fetched from the vendor and built on the box during install. Unfree apps with cache = true (Steam) come from the binary cache

cache.description: Unfree and cached (Steam): a download like a free entry
